source_text:
3.15 Ἀφρικανοῦ Τοῦ θαλαττίου ἐχίνου τὸ σῶμα σώματι ψωριῶντι ἐπιχρισθὲν ὑγιὲς
ἐργάζεται.
pass_a_gloss: 3.15 Of-Africanus. Of-the-sea hedgehog the body to-a-body being-mangy having-been-smeared-on healthy it-makes.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus. The body of the sea hedgehog, smeared on a mangy body, makes it healthy.

choices.why: The lock's sea-echinus, not the land hedgehog of 3.1 and 3.12.
rejected: sea urchin forced where the lock says hedgehog only

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
